findings.description: The state probe reports "ability": {"SHOOT_BOW": null}, so no excerpt shows the tested ability's lock state; the locked/allowed state can only be inferred from count vs. the toml threshold. The same null appears for many item/action abilities across packages.

The only server-side denial lines are client-originated bridge DENIAL_INTENT_DISCOVERED messages; the trace does not record ServerboundUseItemPacket at all, so no row shows that the server-side BowItem.use guard itself fired. The end-to-end lock with the real client is proven (no arrow, no consumption), the server guard is not separately evidenced.
